apihelp-redirectmanager-summary: Maamul dib u jeedinta bogagga (oo leh [[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Extension:RedirectManager|kordhinta RedirectManager]]).
apihelp-redirectmanager-param-redirect: Magaca dib u jeedinta, magaca bogga isha.
apihelp-redirectmanager-param-target: Bogga ay dib u jeedintu ku tilmaami doonto, magaca bogga loo socdo.
apihelp-redirectmanager-example-1: Dib u jeedi jid-gaabinta Buugga Hab dhaqanka boggiisa dhabta ah.
apihelp-redirectmanagerpatterns-summary: Xallinta qaababka cinwaannada bogagga iyadoo la adeegsanayo [[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Extension:RedirectManager|kordhinta RedirectManager]].
apihelp-redirectmanagerpatterns-param-pa: Qaababka cinwaannada bogagga, oo ikhtiyaari ahaan ka koobnaan kara meeleeyayaal sida {number}, {date}, iwm.
apihelp-redirectmanagerpatterns-example-: Hel tusaale cinwaan bog oo ka kooban taariikhda maanta.
